reviews.text: Maria and Paul have looked after our Geoffrey for 6 years. They do a fantastic job, and Geoff is never happier than when going for one of his holidays. Fantastic service, highly recommend.
My dog is so excited and happy, he loves Maria and Paul, excellent service from them, the best they truly love the dogs, jj is more than happy, thank you tillys xx
Fabulous buissnes,  excellent service,  and more importantly,  great communication with my dog, my morkie loves Paul, and Maria, they go above and beyond in making my dog and me happy, 10 out of 10

Paul , maria and betty look after monty our lovely collie . I honestly would not leave him with anyone else .. He always comes back well walked and happy .He sits at the door every morning at 7am waiting for Paul.. Great company and deserves the 5 star review
Great service from true dog lovers, above and beyond for our whippet , Wilma...

My crazy Labrador Pumpkin absolutely adores being walked by Paul (cries at the window waiting for him). We get lots of regular updates of photos and videos of him having such fun. Paul and Maria are always hugely accommodating to any extra walks I need and even helped me out when I got stuck in Dublin overnight and my dog sitter had already left. They both make being a working mum / dog owner so much easier for me and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them. A million stars (5 isn’t enough!)

I can’t recommend Maria and Paul (and of course their dog Betty) at Tilly’s enough!
We previously used them for walks and boarding for our two old dogs. The flexibility they offer around our needs and work at short notice is incredible - they go over and above to offer and incredible service and look after the dogs as if they are their own. It was clear to see just how much the dogs meant to them, as they even came to say their goodbyes to them in both of our dogs final few days.
When we got our latest dog, there was no question about who we would look to go to! Straight away both Maria and Paul have shown exactly the same level of professionlism and real love and care to our boy. I think the fact they are so busy and work pretty much every day should speak for itself about how great their service is!
Tilly’s independent trotters are amazing !! My German shepherd lily loves Paul to bits , would highly recommend!!! Best dog walker ever ❤️

Brilliant dog walker and boarder.  Extremely professional and organised, they have your pet’s safety and fun at the heart of everything they do!  We always know the minute Maria or Paul’s van goes past because Barney goes crazy with excitement and can’t wait to go and walk with his buddies!  He just loves them!
Amazing! Tilly's have taken care of my previous dog and now my new puppy who gets really excited when she's picked up and rides shotgun! Would recommend Tilly's to everyone! ❤️
Tillys is absolutely fabulous. They treat every pet like their own and nothing is ever too much trouble. Cooper loves his time with Paul and Maria xx
Absolutely the best dog walkers in the world and I would totally recommend to anybody wanting somebody who truly cares about your digs welfare

Maria & Paul at Tilly's come highly recommended. They are reliable and brilliant with the dogs in their charge. Vinnie loves his walks with Tilly's Independant Trotters.
Looking for quality dog services, don't hesitate.
Fab service for boarding.  Just back from a 2-week stay and our Springer Spaniel had great time as always!  Tilly's keeps us updated  and reassured that our pooch is being well looked after

My Bertie has been with Maria for the last 4 years from being a pup.  He loves spending time with her and his doggy friends.  He spends his holidays with them when I get chance to get away.  It's like his second home.  I would not trust him with anyone else 😊 Highly recommended x …

Tillys Independent Trotters were really good with my very timid rescue dog Millie. I was really worried about leaving her as she is scared of just about anything but Maria was so patient with her and she had a fab time

We’ve been using Maria for 3 years and our Amber absolutely loves her and her walks!
Communication is always spot on and Amber can’t wait to get out the door when Maria arrives.
My narla loves her walks with maria! Excellent communication and brilliant service! I would highly recommend!!

Maria and Paul are absolutely brilliant. Our rescue spaniel, Nero, has stayed at Tilly’s twice this year (16 nights and 6 nights) and he absolutely loves it there. He can be a bit of a handful due to his past (he’s a rescue), but they care for him so well and always keep us updated, which gives us total peace of mind. They even sent us a photo of Nero joining in the celebrations on our wedding day! We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them. Thank you for everything!
